description.value: Pho Goodness is a Vietnamese comfort food restaurant established in 2011, originally on Davie Street in the West End and now operating three Vancouver locations. The Main & 15th location sits in the heart of the Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, serving pho, banh mi, rice dishes, and vermicelli bowls with dine-in and takeout options. The restaurant has earned multiple 'Best Of City' recognitions from Westender Magazine for best Vietnamese food and best pho.
